verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of outbound warehouse delivery is the integrations page claim that mParticle connects customer data to 'data warehousing solutions with just a few clicks', plus a generic note on forwarding data to downstream services. Warehouse Sync is documented in depth, but it ingests data from the customer's warehouse into mParticle, which is the opposite direction, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented raw event export to Snowflake/BigQuery/ClickHouse/S3, profile export to a warehouse or lake, user-controlled sync scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
